WHAT WE KNOW
USGS gauge at this site did not record any pH or alkalinity data for the period of 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-15.

WHY THE ESTIMATE IS WHAT IT IS
We apply mass balance based on upstream segments COMID 1777642 and COMID 1777628. The observed pH at upstream COMID 1777630 was 7.6, suggesting mildly alkaline conditions. This stability is due to the river passing through sandstone terrain, which buffers against significant changes in pH.

WHAT THE VALUE MEANS
A pH of 7.6 is slightly alkaline — similar to tap water in most cities. It poses no immediate concern for human contact or aquatic life.

UNCERTAINTY & CONFIDENCE
We assigned a moderate confidence level (0.75) due to the limited data available and the possibility that recent rainfall could have changed conditions.

KEY TAKEAWAY
The river's pH at this segment remains mildly alkaline, posing no immediate concerns for aquatic life or human contact.
